I did read #coastal-team, which you're a member of. The newest message there is from 17 Feb 2026, so nothing has been posted in the channel since then. I've saved that as the starting point, so the first digest will only cover messages posted after it.

When the schedule is working, the digest will:
- Run at 09:00 America/Chicago each day, starting tomorrow, 15 Oct.
- Send only to this DM, never to the channel.
- Leave out finance figures such as discounts, rates and prices. The channel already has one from November that I won't repeat in a digest. If you need those, ask June Osei-Lark or Anselm Grieve.

Someone with Gateway admin access needs to fix the scheduler's credentials before I can finish this. Once that's done, ask me again and I'll set it up.
